title: Huoxue Jiedu formula attenuates myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury by modulating LAPTM4B/mTORC1/TFEB pathway-mediated autophagic flux.
authors: Liao, Feifei; Yang, Wenwen; Shi, Junhe; Peng, Yuxuan; Wang, Jie; Li, Hongzheng; Tan, Ling; Long, Linzi; Fu, Changgeng; Qu, Hua
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过LAPTM4B/mTORC1/TFEB通路调节自噬流保护心肌缺血再灌注损伤，核心为细胞自噬与心肌保护，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury (MIRI) severely limits the benefits of revascularization in acute myocardial infarction, with impaired autophagic flux being a central pathological mechanism. The Huoxue Jiedu Formula (HXJDF), a traditional Chinese medicine prescription, has demonstrated cardioprotective potential, yet its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to determine whether HXJDF ameliorates MIRI by restoring impaired autophagic flux and to elucidate the underlying mechanisms. METHODS: MIRI-related genes were identified from GEO transcriptomic datasets through differential expression analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), and intersected with HXJDF putative targets predicted by the SwissTargetPrediction, SuperPred, and SEA databases to obtain candidate genes. Core genes were then prioritized using machine learning algorithms, and key bioactive constituents and candidate targets were further screened through network pharmacology, graph neural network (GNN)-based virtual screening, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations. The cardioprotective effects and mechanisms of HXJDF were systematically investigated using both in vivo rat MIRI models and in vitro hypoxia/reoxygenation (H/R)-injured H9c2 cardiomyoblasts. Evans blue/TTC staining was used to quantify infarct area, while hematoxylin-eosin (HE) staining and myocardial enzyme assays assessed myocardial injury. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) was employed to examine the morphology and distribution of autophagy-related structures. Autophagic flux was monitored using a lentivirus-mediated RFP-GFP-LC3 reporter system combined with confocal microscopy. Western blotting and qPCR were used to quantify the expression of autophagy- and pathway-related molecules. Moreover, a LAPTM4B-knockdown cell model was generated via lentiviral interference. RESULTS: Integrative transcriptomic analysis and machine learning prioritized LAPTM4B as a core candidate target, while GNN-based virtual screening, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations supported a stable interaction between albiflorin and LAPTM4B. In vivo, HXJDF significantly reduced myocardial infarct area, ameliorated histological damage, and lowered serum CK-MB and cTnI levels. It also effectively attenuated abnormal autophagosome accumulation, upregulated LAPTM4B and LAMP1 expression, suppressed mTOR phosphorylation, and downregulated LC3B and p62 expression. In vitro, HXJDF-containing serum improved cell viability, reduced LDH release, decreased the autophagosome-to-autolysosome ratio, and promoted TFEB nuclear translocation. Mechanistically, HXJDF upregulated LAPTM4B expression, inhibited excessive mTORC1 activation, significantly reduced phosphorylation of mTOR and S6K1, alleviated aberrant autophagosome accumulation, decreased LC3B and p62 levels, and increased ATG5 and LAMP1 expression, thereby improving lysosomal function and restoring autophagic flux. Crucially, LAPTM4B knockdown abolished these protective effects and the modulation of the mTORC1/TFEB pathway by HXJDF. CONCLUSION: HXJDF protects against MIRI by restoring autophagic flux via the LAPTM4B/mTORC1/TFEB pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：心肌缺血再灌注损伤（MIRI）严重限制了急性心肌梗死血运重建的获益，其中自噬流受损是核心病理机制之一。活血解毒方（HXJDF）作为一种中药复方，已显示出心脏保护潜力，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在确定HXJDF是否通过恢复受损的自噬流来改善MIRI，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：通过差异表达分析和加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）从GEO转录组数据集中识别MIRI相关基因，并与SwissTargetPrediction、SuperPred和SEA数据库预测的HXJDF推定靶点取交集，获得候选基因。随后使用机器学习算法优先排序核心基因，并通过网络药理学、基于图神经网络（GNN）的虚拟筛选、分子对接和分子动力学模拟进一步筛选关键生物活性成分和候选靶点。利用体内大鼠MIRI模型和体外缺氧/复氧（H/R）损伤的H9c2心肌细胞，系统研究了HXJDF的心脏保护作用及机制。采用Evans blue/TTC染色量化梗死面积，而苏木精-伊红（HE）染色和心肌酶检测评估心肌损伤。使用透射电子显微镜（TEM）检查自噬相关结构的形态和分布。通过慢病毒介导的RFP-GFP-LC3报告系统结合共聚焦显微镜监测自噬流。使用Western blotting和qPCR量化自噬及通路相关分子的表达。此外，通过慢病毒干扰生成了LAPTM4B敲低细胞模型。结果：整合转录组分析和机器学习将LAPTM4B优先排序为核心候选靶点，而基于GNN的虚拟筛选、分子对接和分子动力学模拟支持芍药苷与LAPTM4B之间的稳定相互作用。在体内，HXJDF显著减少心肌梗死面积，改善组织学损伤，并降低血清CK-MB和cTnI水平。它还有效减轻异常自噬体积累，上调LAPTM4B和LAMP1表达，抑制mTOR磷酸化，并下调LC3B和p62表达。在体外，含HXJDF血清提高细胞活力，减少LDH释放，降低自噬体与自噬溶酶体比例，并促进TFEB核转位。机制上，HXJDF上调LAPTM4B表达，抑制过度mTORC1激活，显著降低mTOR和S6K1磷酸化，减轻异常自噬体积累，降低LC3B和p62水平，并增加ATG5和LAMP1表达，从而改善溶酶体功能并恢复自噬流。关键的是，LAPTM4B敲低消除了这些保护效应以及HXJDF对mTORC1/TFEB通路的调节。结论：HXJDF通过LAPTM4B/mTORC1/TFEB通路恢复自噬流，从而保护免受MIRI损伤。
